---
applyTo: "**/*.md"
---

# Markdown rules

These rules apply to Markdown files in this repository.

## Headings

Use sentence case for headings. Use one `#` heading per page. Do not skip heading levels.

## Lists

Use `-` for unordered lists. Use `1.` for ordered steps. Keep list items parallel and short.

## Tables

Use tables for comparisons, service matrices, and structured facts. Keep cells short. If a cell needs a paragraph, use a list or section instead.

## Code and commands

Use inline code for file names, paths, commands, and literal values. Use fenced code blocks for multi-line examples and include a language identifier.

## Links

Use descriptive link text. Prefer relative links for files in this repository. Use official Microsoft links for Azure service details.

## Diagrams

Use Mermaid for service relationships when a diagram is clearer than text. Prefer `graph TD` unless a left-to-right flow is essential.

## Prose

Do not hard-wrap normal prose at an editor width. Keep paragraphs short and focused.
